name: What are the differences between standing seam and corrugated metal roofing?

mainEntity.name: What are the differences between standing seam and corrugated metal roofing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Standing seam and corrugated are two popular styles of metal roofing, differing in aesthetics and installation. Standing seam roofs feature raised, interlocking seams that run vertically, concealing fasteners for a sleek, modern look and superior weather protection. Corrugated metal roofs have a wavy or ribbed profile with exposed fasteners, offering a more traditional or rustic appearance and are often more budget-friendly. Your choice depends on aesthetic preference, budget, and desired level of weather resistance; standing seam generally offers better long-term performance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Standing seam metal roofs have hidden fasteners and raised seams for a sleek look, while corrugated roofs have exposed fasteners and a ribbed profile, impacting aesthetics and weather protection.
